title: Revitalised National Competition Policy
summary: Treasurers agreed a revitalised National Competition Policy on 29 November 2024 and more reforms on 28 November 2025 (zoning, standards, occupational licensing, heavy vehicles, right to repair). Individual reforms have no commencement dates yet.
